an5.100:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.100:1.3: tena kho pana samayena kakudho nāma koḷiyaputto āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno
an5.100:1.4: tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho hoti seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni
an5.100:1.5: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena neva attānaṃ byābādheti no paraṃ byābādheti.
an5.100:2.1: athakho kakudho devaputto yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho kakudho devaputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca
an5.100:2.4: saha cittuppādā ca bhante devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīnoti
an5.100:2.6: idaṃ vatvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an5.100:3.1: athakho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.100:4.1: kakudho nāma bhante koḷiyaputto mamaṃ upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno
an5.100:4.2: tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni
an5.100:4.3: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena neva attānaṃ byābādheti no paraṃ byābādheti.
an5.100:4.4: athakho bhante kakudho devaputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhante kakudho devaputto maṃ etadavoca
an5.100:4.7: sahacittuppādā ca bhante devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīnoti
an5.100:4.9: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
an5.100:5.1: kiṃ pana te moggallāna kakudho devaputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito
an5.100:5.2: yaṃkiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabbantaṃ tatheva hoti no aññathāti
an5.100:5.3: cetasā ceto paricca vidito me bhante kakudho devaputto
an5.100:5.4: yaṃkiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabbantaṃ tatheva hoti no aññathāti.
an5.100:5.7: idāni so moghapuriso attanāva attānaṃ pātukarissati.
an5.100:6.1: pañcime moggallāna satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an5.100:6.3: idha moggallāna ekacco satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:6.5: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:6.6: mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ ārocessāma nāssassa manāpaṃ
an5.100:6.7: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma
an5.100:6.9: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti
an5.100:6.10: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti
an5.100:6.11: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:7.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna idhekacco satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭhoti
an5.100:7.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭhoti
an5.100:7.4: mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma nāssassa manāpaṃ
an5.100:7.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma
an5.100:7.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti
an5.100:7.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti
an5.100:7.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:8.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna idhekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhāti
an5.100:8.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhāti
an5.100:8.4: mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma nāssassa manāpaṃ
an5.100:8.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma
an5.100:8.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti
an5.100:8.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti
an5.100:8.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:9.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna idhekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:9.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:9.4: mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma nāssassa manāpaṃ
an5.100:9.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma
an5.100:9.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti
an5.100:9.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti
an5.100:9.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:10.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna idhekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭikhānāti parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:10.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:10.4: mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma nāssassa manāpaṃ
an5.100:10.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ nu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma
an5.100:10.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti
an5.100:10.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti
an5.100:10.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
an5.100:10.10: ime kho moggallāna pañca satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.100:11.1: ahaṃ kho moggallāna parisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:11.2: na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti na cāhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.3: parisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭhoti
an5.100:11.4: na ca maṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.5: parisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhāti
an5.100:11.6: na ca maṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti na cāhaṃ sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.7: parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:11.8: na ca maṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti na cāhaṃ sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.9: parisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti
an5.100:11.10: na ca maṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmīti.
